title: Return Policy
content: Customers can return products within 30 days of delivery. Products must be unused and in their original packaging. The customer is responsible for return shipping costs unless the product is defective.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are issued after the returned product has been received and inspected. Refunds are normally processed within 5 business days after inspection.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Orders are normally processed within 1 to 2 business days. Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 5 business days after processing.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Customers can cancel an order while it is still processing. Orders that have already been shipped cannot normally be cancelled.
